battle.name: 安市城之戰
battle.brief: 貞觀十九年(645)六月，唐軍進逼遼東安市城。太宗命諸軍作拋石，又於城東南隅築土為臺，逼臨城牆數尺，屢攻不克。七月高句麗遣十五萬援軍，李勣正面迎擊、長孫無忌抄其後。圍城六十餘日，糧道不繼，遼東飛雪，九月班師，十月還洛陽。羅馬弩砲即機械蓄能、專獵城頭守軍的技術譜系西方一端。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 交戰一方是唐帝國，另一方是高句麗。唐太宗以遼東道行軍大總管兼總統諸軍，把大軍拆成北道、東道與海路三線：北道由司空李勣率齊州兵，並糾集契丹、靺鞨諸蕃騎自柳城出；東道由李道宗率河間、昌黎諸州兵出幽州趨平壤；海路則由張亮、牛進達率戰船百餘艘自萊州、登州浮海登陸遼東，兩路會師之後再取平壤。兵種以京師禁軍與各道府兵為骨幹，另雜以契丹、靺鞨、鐵勒等蕃部附庸騎兵；攻城器械由隨軍匠人與尚書省造作，糧秣自幽州、薊州經遼東轉輸，烏骨城一線充作儲糧與轉運的樞紐。高句麗一方由權臣莫離支淵蓋蘇文攝政，國王寶藏王高藏居平壤山城，國政不出一人之手；全國城邑多依山而築、以池沼為帶，兵眾以弓弩手、步卒與槍兵為主，徵發的部眾與役夫分屯各城、烽燧與谿谷之間，軍情由譯騎一日數百里傳回平壤。安市城守軍由大將楊萬春節制，四面拒守，外援則由淵蓋蘇文直接調派，屬於以山城為核心、少騎兵而重弓弩守禦的體系。
countriesEn: The two sides in this war were the Tang empire and the kingdom of Goguryeo. Emperor Taizong of Tang took personal command as Director-General of the Liaodong Circuit and split his army into three columns: a northern column under the minister Li Ji, mixing troops of the Qi prefecture with cavalry supplied by the Khitan and the Mohe tribes and advancing from Liucheng; an eastern column under Li Daozong, leading the troops of Hebei, Changli and other prefectures out of Youzhou toward Pyongyang; and a sea route under Zhang Liang and Niu Jinda, who took more than a hundred warships out of Laizhou and Dengzhou and landed them on the Liaodong peninsula. The land columns were to converge on Ansi before marching on Pyongyang. The core of the Tang army was the imperial guard and the fubing militia of the various circuits, mixed with attached steppe cavalry from the Khitan, the Mohe and the Tiele peoples, while siege engines were built by the artisans attached to the army and by the Ministry of Works, and grain was shifted forward from Youzhou and Jizhou through Liaodong, with Wugu city serving as the pivot for storage and transshipment. On the Goguryeo side real power lay with the regent Yŏn Kaesomun, while the king, Treasure King Gojang, remained in the mountain capital of Pyongyang and the state was run through a council in which the regent's word carried absolute weight. Its cities were almost all built on hillsides and ringed with pools and marshes, its fighting force consisted chiefly of archers and crossbowmen, spearmen and infantry, and conscripted villagers and porters were stationed in garrisons, beacon towers and valley folds, while reports travelled back to Pyongyang on relays of swift riders. The garrison of Ansi was commanded by the general Yang Manchun, who refused every summons to surrender, and the relieving armies were dispatched directly by the regent. The whole system was that of a mountain state: little cavalry, everything built around the bow and the fortified wall.
people: 唐太宗李世民是這場攻堅戰的絕對主角。他親率大軍出玉華門，抵遼東後駐蹕安市城下，既登土山觀敵，又在援軍到來那日自將四千騎兵當先鋒。司空李勣為北道主將，負責正面迎擊高句麗的龐大援軍；尚書左僕射李道宗督工築造逼近城牆的土山，在攻城戰中受傷；中書令蕭瑀屢言糧運不繼、請罷兵，太宗大怒，將他貶出任外州刺史；將軍傅伏愛奉命屯守土山卻私自離營，土山隨即崩塌為敵所據，太宗震怒腰斬之，攻城的勢頭就此折斷。長孫無忌率一萬一千精騎越山抄斷援軍後路，張亮、牛進達掌海路，契苾何力、阿史那思摩等鐵勒、突厥將領隨軍效力，部將薛仁貴於淺水一陣先登陷陣。高句麗方面，攝政莫離支淵蓋蘇文在平壤調兵解圍，安市守將楊萬春屢拒招降，援軍主將高延壽、高惠真被擒後押送長安。
peopleEn: Emperor Taizong of Tang, Li Shimin, was the central figure of the siege. He led the host out of the Yuhua Gate in person, took up his position below the walls of Ansi, climbed the earthen rampart to look at the enemy, and on the day the relief army arrived led four thousand of his own cavalry into the front rank. The minister Li Ji was commander of the northern column and met the Goguryeo relief force head on. The Left Vice Director of the Ministry of State Affairs, Li Daozong, supervised the building of the rampart that was brought up against the wall and was wounded during the assault. The Director of the Secretariat, Xiao Yu, pressed repeatedly for the army to stand down because the supply line could not be stretched, and Taizong, angrily, exiled him to a provincial post. The general Fu Fuai was ordered to hold the rampart with his troops but left his camp on his own initiative; the rampart at once collapsed and was seized by the defenders, and Taizong, furious, had him cut in two, after which the momentum of the siege was broken. Zhangsun Wuji took eleven thousand elite cavalry across the hills to cut the road behind the relieving army, Zhang Liang and Niu Jinda commanded the sea route, and steppe commanders such as Qibi Heli and Ashina Simo fought in the Tang ranks; among the Tang officers, Xue Rengui was the first into the enemy at the crossing of the shallow water. On the Goguryeo side the regent Yŏn Kaesomun dispatched reinforcements from Pyongyang, Yang Manchun defended Ansi and rejected every offer of surrender, and the relief commanders Ko Yŏnsu and Ko Hyejin were taken and sent to the Tang capital.
kits: 卡面是羅馬扭力弩砲，一具以扭力簧束蓄能、發射一支粗重箭矢的投射器，公元前後已在羅馬軍中列裝：攻城時用來獵殺城頭上的目標，野戰中則壓制敵陣前排，與希臘式的投石砲同出一源。東征高句麗的唐軍手上正有這條技術譜系的東方版本，史載太宗命諸軍作拋石，築台於安市城東南隅用以壓射城頭守軍，說的是同一件事——用機械蓄能取代人力拉弓，去打城頭上站著的那幾十個人；只不過唐代拋石所擲的是石彈而不是巨箭，所需的是大量繩索、木架與石料。另一端的對應物是高句麗城頭的弩：弩機同樣靠機括蓄力，卻因體制輕便、可密集布署於城堞，射程與破壞力遠不及砲石，對夯土與條石砌成的城牆幾乎無損，這正是安市能久攻不下的一個器械層面的原因。除投射器外，唐軍還有撞車、雲梯與議而未造的飛橋，高句麗則倚靠木柵、池沼與井水固守；雙方兵員都配備橫刀、馬槊與明光甲，攻城所需木料、繩索、石彈與糧食，全靠遼東的海陸轉輸維持。
kitsEn: The card shows a Roman scorpio, a torsion-powered launcher that stored its energy in twisted skeins of sinew and threw a single heavy bolt, and that was already in service with Roman armies around the beginning of the common era. In sieges it was used to hunt individual men on the wall; in the field it suppressed the front rank of the enemy. It belongs to the same family as the Greek stone-throwing catapults. The Tang army marching against Goguryeo in 645 held the eastern end of that same line of development: the annals record that Taizong ordered the troops to build catapults and raised a platform on the southeastern corner of Ansi to shoot down at the defenders of the wall. The point of the device was identical, a machine storing energy in place of a drawn bow, aimed at the few dozen men standing on the wall; only the payload differed, since the Tang threw stones rather than giant bolts, and needed a great quantity of rope, timber and shot-stones. The counterpart at the other end of the battle was the Goguryeo crossbow: the same lock and trigger mechanism, but light enough to be massed along a parapet, and far shorter in range and destructive effect than a stone, so that against a wall of rammed earth faced with dressed stone it achieved almost nothing. That is one of the material reasons why Ansi held out so long. Beyond the missile weapons the Tang also had battering rams, siege ladders and a bridge that was proposed but never built, while Goguryeo relied on wooden palisades, pools and wells for its defence. The troops on both sides carried swords, long lances and lamellar armour, and every wooden beam, rope, stone and sack of grain the assault required had to be carried forward by sea and land across Liaodong.
tactics: 唐軍的戰法是典型的先取節點、再壓平壤：北道李勣一路連拔蓋牟城以下諸城，東道與海路分別由遼東半島南北兩側切入，最後會師於安市城下，試圖以三面進逼使平壤失去屏障。安市城踞高而築、四周陡坡，正面強攻極耗兵力，太宗遂改用工程手段：先以拋石、撞車覆壓城頭，再於城東南隅人工築起一座高台，土山逐日加高，直至高出城牆數尺，可俯瞰城內並向下直射，台上留兵駐守，成為攻城的階梯。守軍不甘坐困，多次趁夜出城反襲，又在土山崩坍後立即反據高台，唐軍連攻三日不能奪回，器械優勢就這樣被地形與守軍的意志抵銷。援軍解圍之戰是全役最見刀光的一段：李勣以一萬五千步騎正面迎敵，長孫無忌率一萬一千精騎越嶺抄其後，太宗自領四千騎兵直衝鋒線，兩面夾擊之下援軍潰散。然而當糧道拉得太長、遼東十月飛雪、援軍又不斷抵達的時候，唐軍只能放棄攻堅，轉為分道班師，士卒在雪原上拖著腳步回撤。
tacticsEn: The Tang plan was the classical one of seizing the hinge first and then rolling up the enemy. Li Ji took the chain of fortresses from Gaemocheng downward along the northern route, the eastern and the sea columns closed in from the two sides of the Liaodong peninsula, and the three were to join below Ansi so as to roll up Pyongyang from three directions. Ansi itself stood on high ground with steep slopes on every side, and a frontal assault against it cost far more men than it was worth, so Taizong turned to engineering. First the catapults and battering rams were used to sweep the wall; then the army built a great earthen ramp against the southeastern corner of the city and raised it day by day until it stood several feet above the wall, overlooking the town and able to shoot downward, troops being stationed on top so that the rampart became a stairway into the city. The garrison would not sit and be besieged: it sallied by night, and when the ramp collapsed it seized the high ground at once, and the Tang could not retake it in three days of assault. In that way the advantage of the machines was cancelled out by the terrain and by the stubbornness of the defenders. The battle to relieve Ansi is the finest passage of the whole campaign. Li Ji met the enemy face to face with fifteen thousand foot and horse, Zhangsun Wuji took eleven thousand elite cavalry across the ridge to fall on their rear, and Taizong himself led four thousand riders into the front line; caught between the two, the relieving army broke. But once the supply line had been stretched too far, once snow had fallen in Liaodong in October and fresh relieving armies kept coming, the Tang had no choice but to give up the siege, break up and march home, the soldiers dragging themselves back across the snow.
data: 可核的數字大致如下：貞觀十九年正月唐廷下詔出兵，通鑑稱發兵十餘萬；三月李勣出柳城，進拔蓋牟城以下城邑，諸州兵與海路戰船百餘艘同時就位。市攻城自六月二十日前後開始，至九月中旬撤軍為止，前後約三個月，其中真正圍城六十餘日。高句麗援軍由淵蓋蘇文遣高延壽、高惠真等將率領，兵數通鑑作十五萬，現代研究多視為概數，未必為實點。七月那場解圍戰，唐軍投入李勣一萬五千步騎、長孫無忌一萬一千精騎與太宗自領的四千騎兵，兵力對比極其懸殊。戰果方面，通鑑記虜高延壽等帥士三萬六百八十人、馬五萬匹、牛五萬頭、鐵甲十萬副；同書於淺水之戰又記斬首五萬餘級，此數明顯有夸飾，近代史家多以為實數遠低於此。安市為高句麗重鎮，朝鮮方面史書記其城中人口概十萬，可見城域規模；惟圍城本身的傷亡數，諸書皆無可靠記載。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. In the first month of the nineteenth year of Zhenguan, 645, the Tang court issued the order to march and the annals give a host of more than a hundred thousand men. In March Li Ji marched out of Liucheng and took the chain of towns from Gaemocheng, the troops of the various prefectures and the hundred-odd warships of the sea route coming into position at the same time. The siege of Ansi began around the twentieth of June and lasted until the middle of September, roughly three months in all, of which something over sixty days was the actual investment of the town. The relief army was sent by Yŏn Kaesomun under Ko Yŏnsu, Ko Hyejin and other commanders, and its strength is given as a hundred and fifty thousand in the annals, a figure that modern scholarship generally treats as a round estimate rather than a head count. In the battle of the twentieth of July the Tang committed fifteen thousand foot and horse under Li Ji, eleven thousand elite cavalry under Zhangsun Wuji and four thousand riders led by the emperor in person, a disparity of the most extreme kind. Among the results the annals record the capture of Ko Yŏnsu with his officers and troops to the number of 36,080, together with 50,000 horses, more than 50,000 head of cattle and 100,000 suits of iron armour; the same work also gives 50,000 heads cut off at the crossing of the shallow water, a figure plainly inflated, and modern historians believe the real numbers were far lower. Ansi was a major Goguryeo stronghold, and the annals of the Korean court put the population of the town at roughly a hundred thousand, which shows the size of the place; the casualties of the siege itself are not reliably recorded anywhere.
cause: 唐太宗東征高句麗，理由是多層疊加的。第一層是名分：貞觀十八年，高句麗權臣淵蓋蘇文廢黜國王寶藏王高藏，專權自為，並遣使請改國號為高麗；唐廷議其貢奉不絕而禮絕，遂以廢主謀逆與拒絕臣禮為名出兵。第二層是地緣：新羅在漢江上游與高句麗爭地，屢次入朝乞師，唐廷藉聯盟牽制高句麗南翼；北方契丹、靺鞨與高句麗犬牙交錯，唐軍也須切斷它與靺鞨、突厥之間的聯繫。第三層是雪恨：隋煬帝三征高句麗而亡國，太宗自幼聞之，欲以新朝之兵雪前朝之恥，並藉此打通從遼東直抵平壤的通道，建立唐朝在東亞的秩序。第四層是朝議：主戰者以為高句麗易取，反對者憂其勞師糜費、墜唐之威，最後太宗仍決定用兵，但內部阻力從未消失，戰前籌畫屢改，戰後追悔亦由此起。
causeEn: Taizong's invasion of Goguryeo had several layers of cause. The first was a matter of title and legitimacy. In the eighteenth year of Zhenguan, 644, the regent Yŏn Kaesomun deposed the king, Treasure King Gojang, and ruled alone, and he then sent an envoy asking to change the name of the state to Goguryeo. The Tang court judged that Goguryeo continued to send tribute while abandoning courtesy, and used the deposition of its ruler and the refusal of court etiquette as the pretext for war. The second layer was geography. Silla was fighting Goguryeo for the upper Han river and appealed to the Tang for help, so the court could hold the southern flank of Goguryeo in check through an alliance; and on the northern frontier the Khitan and the Mohe interdicted Goguryeo's territory, so the Tang had also to cut its communications with the Mohe and the Turks. The third layer was revenge. Sui Yangdi had destroyed himself in three failed campaigns against Goguryeo, and Taizong, who had heard the story since childhood, meant to avenge the ruin of the former dynasty with the arms of the new one, to open a road from Liaodong straight to Pyongyang, and to set up a Tang order in East Asia. The fourth layer was debate at court. Those in favour thought Goguryeo easy to take; those opposed feared a long war, wasted provisions and the loss of Tang prestige. Taizong in the end decided to fight, but the opposition never died away: the plan was revised again and again before the campaign, and the regret after it grew out of the same root.
impact: 安市一役是唐太宗第一次大規模東征的終點，雖然沒有拿下一座城，卻改變了唐朝此後對東北的整套做法。唐軍此役雖破高句麗十餘城、拓地至鴨綠水下游，卻在安市耗盡銳氣：糧道自幽州至平壤一千餘里，轉輸一票不易，援軍不斷北來，守軍死守不退，兩相加議，唐廷明白一次速決並不可行。於是政策從速戰速決、畢其功於一役，轉為長期消耗加上扶植新羅：先以羈縻與聯盟牽制，再於貞觀二十二年後接連用兵，永徽六年蘇定方拔平壤，總章元年高句麗國滅。高句麗方面，安市守住了，遂得以延續二十餘年，但全民徵發、戶口銳減與宮廷內鬥同時加深，莫離支一死，三子爭位，國勢在混亂中崩潰。戰術層面的教訓更直接：唐廷此後重視攻城器械的體系化與海運糧秣，幽州、營州一線的前沿基地與倉儲被重新配置；高句麗則加固山城防禦，囤糧、蓄水、層層內城成為標準配置，太宗亦為戰歿將士於幽州立祠，出身的府兵家庭從此對高句麗之戰記憶深刻。
impactEn: The siege of Ansi was the end of the first of Taizong's great eastern campaigns, and although not one city was taken it changed the whole of the Tang court's later approach to the northeast. The army broke through more than a dozen Goguryeo strongholds and pushed the frontier down to the lower Yalu, yet it spent its edge at Ansi. The supply line ran more than a thousand li from Youzhou to Pyongyang and was ruinous to stretch, relieving armies kept arriving from the north, the garrison refused to give way, and the two together taught the court that a single decisive stroke was not to be had. Policy therefore turned from trying to end the war in one quick blow to a long attritional campaign combined with the support of Silla: first to restrain Goguryeo through the alliance, then to resume the war in earnest after the twentieth year of Zhenguan, until Su Dingfang took Pyongyang in 655 and the state was destroyed in 668. On the Goguryeo side Ansi held, and the kingdom survived for another twenty years or more, but universal conscription, the loss of households and the quarrels of the court deepened together; when the regent died, his three sons fought over the succession and the state collapsed amid that disorder. The tactical lessons were even more direct. From then on the Tang gave weight to the systematic use of siege engines and to carrying provisions by sea, and the forward bases and depots along the Youzhou and Yingzhou lines were reconfigured. Goguryeo in turn hardened the doctrine of the mountain city, with stores of grain, standing water and nested inner walls becoming standard, and Taizong had a shrine built at Youzhou for the soldiers who had fallen, so that the fubing households of the north carried the memory of the Goguryeo war for a generation.
result: 結果是唐軍沒有攻下安市。土山崩塌、守軍反據高台、器械攻城屢挫，糧道又被援軍與雪寒拖垮，太宗在七月下詔罷兵，軍隊經雪原回撤，十月回到洛陽。撤軍途中遇上風雪，士卒僵仆、凍餓而死者不少，太宗一面收容傷兵，一面把契苾何力、阿史那思摩等受傷的蕃將安置在帳中治療。市安之戰由此成了唐軍第一次在攻堅與遠征補給上雙雙失手的記錄，太宗歸朝後深悔此役，責傅伏愛失守土山、歎用人不當。這一場敗退並非全無所得：唐軍拔城十餘，俘虜三萬餘人、馬牛十萬餘頭，取其甲兵以實軍，高句麗在遼東的屏障雖然保住，國力卻被這場戰役大量消耗。從長時段看，安市城仍是唐軍未竟事業的標誌：直到二十三年後，唐羅聯軍才真正拿下平壤，高句麗的城防體系才宣告崩潰。
resultEn: The outcome was that Ansi was never taken. The rampart collapsed, the garrison seized the high ground, the engines achieved nothing, and the supply line was broken down by the relieving armies and by the cold; in the seventh month Taizong ordered the army to stand down, the column dragged itself back across the snow, and in the tenth month the emperor was in Luoyang again. Snow caught them on the road and many soldiers died of cold and hunger; Taizong gathered up the wounded, and had the wounded steppe commanders, Qibi Heli and Ashina Simo among them, cared for in his own tent. The siege of Ansi thus became the record of the first time the Tang army had failed in both respects, in siegecraft and in the supply of a distant expedition, and the emperor regretted it bitterly on his return, blaming Fu Fuai for letting the rampart go and lamenting his choice of men. The withdrawal was not without profit. The Tang took more than ten towns, carried off more than thirty thousand prisoners, over a hundred thousand horses and cattle and a great quantity of armour and weapons; Goguryeo kept its shield in Liaodong, but its strength was heavily drained by the campaign. In the long run the fortress remained a mark of Tang work left undone: it took another twenty-three years, and a Tang-Silla alliance, before Pyongyang fell and the Goguryeo system of fortified towns came down for good.
